<html lang="de">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">

body{margin:0;display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:100vh;background:#F2E8D5;font-family:system-ui,sans-serif}
button{padding:12px 20px;border:0;border-radius:12px;background:#1F6F5C;color:#F2E8D5;font-size:16px;transition:transform .2s ease}
